children: Solv Protocol is scheduled to release 159.32 million SOLV in an April 2027 token unlock. The release includes tokens allocated to the ecosystem, investors and the team.

The amount set to unlock equals 2.70% of the token's circulating supply. Once the lock on those allocations lifts, investors and team members can sell tokens that were previously locked, adding to the potential sell supply.

title: Solv Protocol: 159.32 Million SOLV Unlock - Apr 2027
